_memory_banks_note: Empty on purpose. umi's three banks were read off its own ABL-patched DTB;
nio has 8 GiB and a different carveout layout, so copying them would lie.
Fill this list from the payload's '>= 64 MiB Conventional run' dump
(the block that prints '<phys>  <MiB>  Conventional' for up to 14 runs),
keeping only the runs XNU may own, in ascending base order.
The generator refuses to run while this list is empty.

timer.note: CNTFRQ 19.2 MHz confirmed by the payload's own 100 Hz reload (192000 ticks); the payload currently drives the physical timer on PPI 30, XNU takes the virtual one.

framebuffer.source: uefiplat.cfg 'Display Reserved' 0x9C000000+0x2400000 plus dumpsys display 1080x2520; handed over in boot_args, not initialised by this ADT

storage.note: A/B device: boot_a on sdd, userdata on sde (LUN 4). umi's single-LUN UFS path needs a LUN selector before it can read nio's userdata.

sources.evidence_snapshot: 2026-10-31 nio dump (fastboot oem partition / oem hw / getevent, LineageOS extracted DTs)
